Name: Address types to collect
Description: The types of addresses that are collected while paying the invoice

Name: All Transactions Fee Name
Description: Name of the all-transactions checkout fee

Name: All Transactions Fee Percentage
Description: Percentage of the all-transactions checkout fee at time of contract creation

Name: Allowed Commerce Payment Methods
Description: Accepted forms of HubSpot supported payment methods for invoices on this contract

Name: Allowed payment methods
Description: The payment methods that can be collected while paying the invoice
Options: Credit or Debit Card (credit_or_debit_card); ACH (ach); SEPA (sepa); BACS (bacs); PADS (pads)

Name: Associated Companies
Description: Ids of companies associated to this contract.

Name: Automated sales tax enabled
Description: If automated sales tax is enabled

Name: Billing address city
Description: The city the customer entered for billing.

Name: Billing address country
Description: The country the customer entered for billing.

Name: Billing address country code
Description: The ISO country code used for billing

Name: Billing address line 1
Description: The street address the customer entered for billing.

Name: Billing address line 2
Description: The apartment, unit number, or building the customer entered for billing. This is an optional field.

Name: Billing address state
Description: The state the customer entered for billing.

Name: Billing address zip
Description: The zip code the customer entered for billing.

Name: Card Fee Name
Description: Name of the credit/debit card checkout fee

Name: Card Fee Percentage
Description: credit/debit card checkout fee percentage applied per payment / invoice

Name: Collection process
Description: Describes the payment collection process for the contract i.e. automatic vs manual

Name: Contract effective date
Description: The date when the contract becomes legally effective

Name: Contract Source
Description: Identifies the method or channel used to create the contract
Options: Quote (quote); CRM UI (crm_ui) [HIDDEN]; API (api); Import (import); Contract UI (contract_ui); Payment Link (payment_link) [HIDDEN]

Name: Contract source id
Description: Stores the ID of the specific source object that triggered the contract's creation. This field can be null for sources like crm_ui or import where a specific source object ID may not apply.

Name: Created by user ID
Description: The user who created this record. This value is set automatically by HubSpot.

Name: Object create date/time
Description: The date and time at which this object was created. This value is automatically set by HubSpot and may not be modified.

Name: Currency code
Description: The currency code of the contract.

Name: Current annual recurring revenue in company currency
Description: The current annual recurring revenue, using the exchange rate, rounded to the portal's home currency decimal places, in your company's currency

Name: Current monthly recurring revenue in company currency
Description: The current monthly recurring revenue, using the exchange rate, rounded to the portal's home currency decimal places, in your company's currency

Name: Direct Debit Fee Name
Description: Name of the direct debit checkout fee

Name: Direct Debit Fee Percentage
Description: Direct debit checkout fee percentage per payment / invoice

Name: Discount code
Description: The discount code(s) used when the contract was created

Name: Contract end date
Description: The date when the contract expires

Name: Error reason
Description: Reason for the contract's error status
Options: Import error - Missing line items (import_error_missing_line_items); Import error - Missing contact (import_error_missing_contact); Import error - Negative line item (import_error_negative_line_item); Unknown import error (unknown_import_error)

Name: Exchange rate
Description: This is the exchange rate used to convert the contract amount into your company currency.

Name: HubSpot billing enabled
Description: Indicates whether the contract is billed via HubSpot or if it is used just for storing data

Name: Invoice preset id
Description: Invoice preset to be used for billed invoices (if empty uses the portal default)

Name: Language
Description: The language for displaying this contract

Name: Object last modified date/time
Description: Most recent timestamp of any property update for this object. This includes HubSpot internal properties, which can be visible or hidden. This property is updated automatically.

Name: Locale
Description: The locale for displaying this contract

Name: Merged record IDs
Description: The list of record IDs that have been merged into this record. This value is set automatically by HubSpot.

Name: Name
Description: name of the contract

Name: Net Payment Terms
Description: Refers to the period, expressed in days (e.g., Net 30), within which contract invoices must be paid

Name: Record ID
Description: The unique ID for this record. This value is set automatically by HubSpot.

Name: Record source detail 1
Description: First level of detail on how this record was created.

Name: Record source detail 2
Description: Second level of detail on how this record was created.

Name: Record source detail 3
Description: Third level of detail on how this record was created.

Name: Record source
Description: How this record was created.

Name: Payment enabled
Description: Indicates if a pay-now checkout link should be included on invoices with manual collection method

Name: Payment method
Description: The stored payment method associated to the contract

Name: Payment method source at creation
Description: Indicates where a payment method is collected when creating a contract
Options: First invoice (first_invoice); Payment method on file (payment_method_on_file)

Name: PO number
Description: The purchase order number for the contract

Name: Renewal contract id
Description: Record id of the renewal contract

Name: Renewal date
Description: The date when the contract should be renewed

Name: Renewal terms
Description: Details on how the contract renewal should be handled

Name: Contract start date
Description: The date when the overall contract term begins, marking the start of the contract agreement and when services can begin

Name: Status
Description: Current status of the contract
Options: Active (active); Completed (completed); Terminated (terminated); Draft (draft); Scheduled (scheduled_activation); Error (error); Paused (paused)

Name: Store Payment Method At Checkout
Description: Allow customers to store their payment method at checkout.

Name: Termination date
Description: The date upon which a contract is or will be terminated.

Name: Total contract value in company currency
Description: The total contract value, using the exchange rate, rounded to the portal's home currency decimal places, in your company's currency

Name: Updated by user ID
Description: The user who last updated this record. This value is set automatically by HubSpot.

Name: Owner assigned date
Description: The most recent timestamp of when an owner was assigned to this record. This value is set automatically by HubSpot.

Name: Contract owner
Description: The owner of the contract.

Name: Owner's main team
Description: The main team of the record owner. This value is set automatically by HubSpot.

Name: Annual contract value
Description: represents the annualized recurring revenue from a contract, excluding one-time charges

Name: Current annual recurring revenue
Description: The expected recurring revenue generated on an annual basis

Name: Current monthly recurring revenue
Description: The expected recurring revenue generated on a monthly basis

Name: Pre-termination contract value
Description: The total contract value immediately before the contract was terminated. This field is populated regardless of whether the contract is terminated.

Name: Total billed amount
Description: The total of all billed invoice amounts, including both open and paid invoices

Name: Total billed amount (pre-tax)
Description: The total of all billed invoice amounts before tax, including both open and paid invoices

Name: Total collected fees
Description: The total of all checkout fees on paid invoices

Name: Total collected taxes
Description: The total of all taxes on paid invoices

Name: Total contract value
Description: The total contract value (TCV) from all associated line items.

Name: Total paid amount
Description: The total of all paid invoice amounts, including both open and paid invoices

Name: Seller company address
Description: The street address of the seller company

Name: Seller company address 2
Description: The second line of the street address of the seller company

Name: Seller company city
Description: The city in which the seller company is located

Name: Seller company country
Description: The country in which the seller company is located

Name: Seller company domain
Description: The domain of the seller company

Name: Seller company name
Description: The name of the seller company

Name: Seller company state/region
Description: The state/region in which the seller company is located

Name: Seller company postal code
Description: The zip code in which the seller company is located

Name: Seller email
Description: Email address of the seller

Name: Seller first name
Description: First name of the seller

Name: Seller last name
Description: Last name of the seller

Name: Seller phone
Description: Phone number of the seller
